name: From Crowdsourced Data to High-Quality Benchmarks: Arena-Hard and BenchBuilder Pipeline
problem: Manual curation of high-quality LLM benchmarks is expensive and doesn't scale.
mechanism: BenchBuilder: automated pipeline using LLMs to curate prompts from crowdsourced data (Chatbot Arena, WildChat-1M). Arena-Hard-Auto: 500 challenging prompts with 3x higher separation than MT-Bench, 98.6% correlation with human preference rankings, at $20 cost.
notes:
arXiv preprint, no venue claim in comments. This paper directly addresses benchmarking criticism: it shows that MT-Bench has low separation between models and proposes a more discriminative alternative. The 3x higher separation claim is the paper's own measurement. The $20 cost is for LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
